verdict.rationale: mParticle clearly has an audience feature: users create audiences and connect them to outputs for activation (x2, 19, 20, 7). Its marketing describes stating an audience goal while mParticle suggests the logic (22), which implies a no-SQL path. However, the evidence never documents a visual builder working on traits and behavior, or any audience size estimate before activation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual trait/behavior builder, a pre-activation estimated audience size, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
